evals.prompt: Review a pull request adding a search endpoint that uses string concatenation in SQL queries.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies SQL injection vulnerability, rates it as HIGH/CRITICAL severity with file:line evidence, and provides a parameterized query fix.
expectations: Identifies SQL injection pattern in query string concatenation
Rates vulnerability severity accurately with file:line reference

evals.prompt: Check our Express server middleware configuration for security headers and CORS policy.
evals.expected_output: The skill audits security headers (helmet, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options) and CORS configuration, reporting missing security headers.
expectations: Checks for essential security headers like CSP and X-Content-Type-Options
Audits CORS allowed origins for security risks
Provides clear remediation middleware code snippets

evals.prompt: Perform security review on a custom JWT authentication implementation and password reset flow.
evals.expected_output: The skill flags custom auth and crypto design with REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW label while identifying any specific security flaws.
expectations: Applies REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW label to auth and crypto design flows
Reviews token expiration, signing secret handling, and rate limiting
Outputs structured security report adhering to severity rubric
